members.title: Review: Onimusha: Way Of The Sword (Switch 2) - Capcom Delivers A Superb Samurai Revival
members.summary: Dawn of a new dream. There’s a lot riding on Onimusha: Way of the Sword . Capcom has a few dormant franchises in its dusty closets just waiting to be revived, yet this one feels particularly significant. Despite never really taking off commercially, Onimusha commanded a passionate fanbase that continues to hold the series in the highest regard – right up there with the likes of Resident Evil and Devil May Cry . So to bring back Onimusha with a brand-new mainline entry in 2026 — two decades after the last game — feels especially risky, but it’s one that I’m happy to report has largely paid off.
